notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: a much broader curated model catalog in the provider picker — strong, balanced and fast/cheap (and :free) models across Anthropic, DeepSeek, Kimi/Moonshot, OpenRouter (Claude/DeepSeek/OpenAI/Gemini/Llama/Qwen/Mistral/Grok/Kimi), NVIDIA NIM and OpenAI-compatible providers — so you can rotate and combine through the existing OpenRouter provider order, the Sidekick fallback chain and the local-model fallback. Every prior model is kept; no wire protocol, base URL, provider offering or saved key changed. OpenCode Zen stays unoffered (its gateway rejects third-party clients); its hosted models are reachable via the OpenRouter presets. Existing tools untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU/PTY terminal, Phone Control (Shizuku/Wireless ADB/root), in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
